about.lead:
Hi, I'm David. 👋

I'm an Electrical and Computer Engineer (MSc) specialized in software development and control systems. Throughout my career I've built systems for CERN particle accelerators and for pharma filling lines (critical regulated environments). I'm comfortable between code and hardware: software, infrastructure, networks, and the in-between (version control, testing, CI/CD). I've led teams, mentored junior engineers, handled clients, and done 24/7 on-call support. Aerospace nerd, AI enthusiast. English and Portuguese fluent, French B1 and improving.

TL;DR: Python, CI/CD, Linux, Networks, Control Systems

items.item1: Develop SCADA process visualization and data acquisition software for pharmaceutical production systems in zenon, C# and SQL, working across concurrent customer-facing projects under formal version and change control.
items.item2: Implement systems integration between the supervisory layer, MES, PLCs, and customer IT-OT infrastructure, debugging and resolving integration issues across heterogeneous environments.
items.item3: Write and execute test plans and test programs as part of GMP system qualification, maintaining traceability between requirements, implementation and test evidence.
items.item4: Deploy and commission systems on Windows Server and VMware ESXi infrastructure at SKAN and at customer sites, working directly with client teams through requirements, on-site handover and acceptance.

controlFellow.title: Senior Control Software Engineer (Fellow)
controlFellow.company: CERN - European Center for Nuclear Research

items.item1: Designed, commissioned and maintained distributed control systems for high-power converter plants across the CERN accelerator complex, running on tens of PLCs and thousands of IO points.
items.item2: Led and developed a Python-based CI/CD automated testing framework for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and functional validation of control software against Siemens S7-1500 PLCs over OPC-UA, building and maintaining the GitLab CI runners on Windows and Linux, with automated log analysis, test execution, and report generation across pipelines.
items.item3: Recruited and supervised a Master's student for 9 months contributing to the Python CI/CD framework.
items.item4: Internal support coordinator for the section from 2023, leading a team of 5 supporting real-time control software and hardware. Analyzed the service workflow, identified the bottleneck, and made the case to management for a tool that substantially reduced the cost of the service.
items.item5: Solved urgent operational issues for power converter control systems as a 24/7 standby service, maintaining high availability for the accelerator complex.

controlPjas.title: Junior Control Software Engineer (PJAS)
controlPjas.company: CERN - European Center for Nuclear Research

items.item1: Developed advanced control libraries, HMI widgets and operator panels in CTRL++ (C++ syntax-based language) for power converter control systems across CERN, deploying and maintaining the applications on Linux servers.
items.item2: Implemented industrial communication protocols (S7, IEC-104, MODBUS, PROFINET and PROFIBUS) between field devices and SCADA.
items.item3: Owned testing of the new supervisory applications commissioned during Long Shutdown 2, supporting the power engineers through the accelerator restart.
items.item4: Developed Python, Bash, and PowerShell scripts to automate consistent file directory structure for the team's projects.

items.item1: Built a Python/Qt desktop application to schedule, launch, and monitor CI/CD testing pipelines for mixed-signal electronics.
Developed robotic process automation (RPA) scripts and tests.

genevaHackathon.title: Swiss {ai} Weeks Geneva Hackathon 2026
genevaHackathon.description: Led the development of an AI negotiation simulator for humanitarian negotiators, in a team of 5. An LLM plays the counterpart, but the score comes from rules in an editable scenario file: every criterion needs a quote from the trainee as evidence, and a live trainer console steers the negotiation (Python, Streamlit, LLMs, ElevenLabs voice).

homelab.title: Self-hosted infrastructure (home-lab)
homelab.description: Running a self-hosted home server environment with Docker containers, NAS storage, and home network services, covering container deployment, storage configuration, Linux and network administration outside of work. Building and running AI agents on it with Claude Code and Hermes Agent (Nous Research) to help manage my workflows.
